messages:
anya_sales: Quick question — we need a nimble private-offer structure for AWS/GCP marketplace tied to our hardware partner program. Goal: let partners commit spend (3/6/12 mo) and receive reserved-capacity discounts + SI implementation credits. What are the constraints (legal, billing, provisioning)?

kevin_partners: +1. My initial thought: 3 tiers (3/6/12):
- Tier A (Starter): 10% off, 3mo min, partner gets $5k integration credit
- Tier B (Scale): 18% off, 6mo min, $20k credit + priority scheduling for dedicated nodes
- Tier C (Enterprise): 25% off, 12mo min, reserved nodes + co-marketing budget
Also allow top-up commits mid-term with pro-rated benefits. Need to decide if discounts apply to token usage only or also infra add-ons.

alex_goldman: Need to model the revenue recognition & churn impact. Discounts look reasonable but confirm breakage on credits. Suggest cap on credits per customer to avoid abuse. Also require mapping SKUs to GL codes.

lina_ops: Legal notes: auto-renew by default with 30-day opt-out window, unless customer checks explicit one-time term. For private/on-prem offers we need an addendum for data residency + support SLAs. No stacking: discounts cannot stack with other promo credits unless explicitly allowed.

sam_engineering: Operational constraints: dedicated/reserved nodes require ~6 weeks lead time for procurement/provisioning in some regions. For cloud marketplace private offers, we can expose two SKUs: "dedicated-reserved" and "burst-on-demand". Also propose a low-memory quantized SKU for cost-sensitive partners. SI credits should be redeemable in our partner-portal as tickets (we'll need billing API changes).

kevin_partners: For the SI model, prefer credits that map to line-items on the invoice so SIs can invoice against them. Also want an ability for partners to bundle hardware + cloud credits in a single private offer.

anya_sales: Can we sketch a sample SKU mapping for the partner so they can preview pricing?

alex_goldman: Sure. Draft example:```
SKU,Description,CommitTermMonths,Discount%,PartnerCreditCap
RED-DED-STD,Dedicated small node,3,10,5000
RED-DED-MED,Dedicated medium node,6,18,20000
RED-DED-ENT,Dedicated reserved cluster,12,25,50000
RED-QUANT-LM,Quantized low-memory instance,any,12,0
RED-SI-CREDIT,SI implementation credit,any,0,variable
```
This should be accompanied by a clause: "credits expire at end of term unless consumed" and a true-up at renewal based on actual usage.

lina_ops: Addendum: include audit right for usage true-up and clear refund/forfeit language for unused credits. Also require partner to accept co-marketing terms before logo usage.

sam_engineering: Tech notes: we'll need to add an entitlement flag in the billing API (entitlements.partner_credit_id) so the marketplace UI can surface remaining credits. Also API to redeem credits against onboarding services. I'll scope the ticket.

anya_sales: Joint announcement cadence — target Q3 product summit for a coordinated launch with HW partner + 1 SI. Deliverables: joint press release, demo lab at summit, 2 customer case studies in first 6 months. Who drafts PR & owns approvals?

kevin_partners: I'll draft comms with partner. Need legal and marketing sign-off. Recommend we lock messaging 6 weeks before summit. Also request partner logos + 1 pager by then.

marketplace-bot: New private offer draft created in Marketplace console: offer-id=PO-20260412-77. Link: https://marketplace.example.com/offers/PO-20260412-77

alex_goldman: Add a billing clause: private offers are non-transferrable and discounts do not stack with promotional credits unless explicitly listed. Also require a 45-day invoice freeze period for committed spend true-ups.

lina_ops: Noted. Add enforcement language for misuse and a rights-to-terminate clause if commit is gamed.

sam_engineering: For SI integrations, create an "implementation SKU" that maps 1 credit = 1 engineer-day (or configurable). That will make accounting + redemption straightforward. We should also provide a simple webhook for SI portals when credits are consumed.

anya_sales: Great — can we get a concrete spreadsheet (tiers, discounts, credit caps, renewal terms, PR timeline) by EOD Friday? I want to share with the HW partner and lock in dates.

kevin_partners: I'll send a draft spreadsheet and calendar invite for a partner sync. Ping me if you need it sooner. :thumbsup:
